role: Real accessibility scanner against real HTML — missing alt attributes, form inputs with no real label association. Same regex-scanning discipline as E-07/E-13. Read-only.
behaviorDescription: scanPage() checks real HTML for missing alt attributes on img tags and inputs with no id or aria-label, verified against a clean case (zero findings) and a real broken case before implementation.
hardStops: Never modifies any page content — strictly read-only scanning
Never fabricates a finding not grounded in a real regex match against the actual HTML
